errors.text_span: y轴标签为关键词完全覆盖率
errors.evidence: The y-axis label in the image is '关键词覆盖率%' (Keyword coverage rate %), not '关键词完全覆盖率' (Keyword complete coverage rate). The word '完全' (complete) is not present in the axis label itself.
The chart is a grouped bar chart (分组柱状图), not a line chart or something described as 'bar lines' (柱状线). This incorrectly describes the type of visual element used to represent the data.
